entries.context: Game title, largest text on the title screen. Product name; keep untranslated unless marketing provides a localized name.
Subtitle under the game title: the name of the first mystery case. 'Lantern Lane' is the street's name.
Title screen button that starts the case from the beginning. Short, fits a child-sized button.
Title screen button that resumes saved progress. Shown only when a save exists.
Development-build-only button. {0} is the native name of the current language, e.g. 'English'.
Small corner label for testers. {0} is the app version, {1} is a build identifier. Not translated by marketing.

First prompt after starting, shown on touch screens on a small paper tag just above the on-screen stick ghost, so 'here' means that spot. Plain instruction for children 8–12; keep it under about 24 characters.

entries.value: Use W A S D or the arrow keys to walk.
entries.context: First prompt after starting, keyboard players. Key names may stay in Latin letters.

entries.value: Use the left stick to walk.
entries.context: First prompt after starting, gamepad players.
On-screen pause button label and accessibility name. Very short.
On-screen jump button label. Very short, fits a round thumb button.
On-screen contextual action button fallback label when no specific verb applies.
Pause menu button that returns to play.
Pause menu button that returns to the title screen.
